name: Monster Girl Quest (Complete)
summary: Legendary sprawling 3-part monster-girl adventure saga famous for shockingly epic shonen boss music, humor, and massive sequel RPGs.
ranking_rationale: Starts like comedy smut and unexpectedly blooms into a gripping epic RPG story; weighed against purely linear rock-paper-scissors encounter battle system in part 1–3.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.
